client_requirement: A real graphical Minecraft Java Edition 26.1.2 client must execute this scenario through the repo-native Gradle runClient adapter (:fabric-agent:runClientAgent, net.neoforged.moddev). That client carries the repo's JVM client-agent bridge for observation only and deliberately does NOT load the Solaris Loader mod, so the greeting and /hello arrive over the ordinary vanilla-compatible play protocol; it is a no-Loader development client, not an uninstrumented production binary. Protocol bots, wire probes and mock clients do not satisfy this gate.

automation_runner.client_isolation: The primary Gradle runClient uses a per-run game directory and the fixed offline username SolarisPrimary.

scenarios.title: External WASM package join greeting and /hello in a no-Loader graphical client
steps: Start Solaris from the prepared run directory with the plugins deployment configured as runtime = "wasm", strict = true and expected = ["hello"]; the server must publish readiness with the external component admitted or fail startup.
Launch the real graphical 26.1.2 client through the repo-native Gradle runClient adapter (no Solaris Loader mod) and let the agent driver connect it to the loopback server address.
Enter Play as the ordinary non-operator player SolarisPrimary and require the client chat to render the guest's configured join greeting for that live player name.
Send the ordinary command /hello and require a fresh guest answer in client chat, then repeat it and require another fresh answer.
Send one command root no package declares and require fresh server rejection feedback.
Capture the actual client surface after the greeting and answers and after the rejected command.
expected_observations: The graphical client reaches Play against the strict wasm deployment and stays in Play for the whole scenario.
The join greeting rendered in client chat equals the configured template with the live player name.
Each /hello submission produces a fresh expected answer line in client chat.
The unregistered command produces fresh server rejection feedback.
No operator privileges are granted and no debug/operator command is used to produce any observed line.
